title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) here, or tap More info on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig into it.

items.headline_md: A **drone attack on a "vital facility" in Kuwait** kills **two Italian technicians**; Kuwait blames Iran, which denies it
items.summary_md: Italy says the victims worked for Rheinmetall's Italian unit; Iran's foreign minister offered Kuwait a joint investigation.

items.headline_md: Iran's IRGC Navy says **two more tankers hit mines** north of Oman's Khasab port in the **Strait of Hormuz**
items.summary_md: It says one was a supertanker carrying over 2 million barrels of crude that was abandoned burning.

items.headline_md: A **Thanksgiving storm on the East Coast** leaves **800,000+ without power** and snarls flights
items.summary_md: High-wind and flood warnings ran from Virginia Beach to New York City; the Macy's parade was moved to Saturday, its first postponement in 100 years (per THR).

items.headline_md: An **EU summit fails to agree** the 2028–2034 budget and a **€45 billion Ukraine loan** after 12+ hours
items.summary_md: Macron said leaders will return to it on Dec. 17–18; Bulgaria, Czechia, Hungary and Slovakia objected to EU funds for military aid.

items.headline_md: Update: the Indonesia mine toll rises to **13 dead**, with **13 still missing** in a flooded West Java pit
items.summary_md: Rescuers have been pumping water from the roughly 100-meter shaft since Wednesday.

items.headline_md: **Serbia** will hold an **early presidential election on Dec. 27**
items.summary_md: Parliament Speaker Aleksandar Cupic announced the date in a televised address.

items.headline_md: **Trump calls revised GDP numbers "fake"** and demands an investigation after Q3 growth was revised to **4.3%** from 3.4%
items.summary_md: He offered no evidence for his claim that pre-election figures were deliberately under-reported, Bloomberg reports.

items.headline_md: Black Friday: NRF expects **182.7 million** Thanksgiving-weekend shoppers, down 2%, but Adobe sees **$47.5B+ online**, up 7%
items.summary_md: A Bank of America survey found the share planning to concentrate buying on Black Friday fell from 25% to 17%.

items.headline_md: Update: **China, Japan, the EU and others reject** the US case for new tariffs on **14 economies**
items.summary_md: China, facing 20% that could double to 40%, reserved the right to retaliate; the US-China truce runs to Jan. 10, 2027.

items.headline_md: The **Bank of Korea raises its rate to 3.25%**, a two-year high and its third hike this year
items.summary_md: The KOSPI rose 0.29% to 4,711.21 the same day.

items.headline_md: Spain's **Pablo Hernández de Cos** is set to be backed as the next **ECB president**, succeeding Lagarde
items.summary_md: EU officials said leaders were expected to back him; he and the Netherlands' Klaas Knot were nominated on Nov. 6.

items.headline_md: Samsung's **Jay Y. Lee turned down Elon Musk's** offer of a long-term memory chip deal, even with Musk financing a new plant
items.summary_md: SamMobile reported it citing The Wall Street Journal.

items.headline_md: Mobile: **Block Blast** tops Google Play's worldwide weekly installs (**+7.5M**), with Voodoo's **Paper.io 2** at No. 9
items.summary_md: HungryStudio's Block Blast Lite (+3.1M) is No. 10 and Vita Mahjong (+3M) No. 12 for Nov. 20–27.

items.headline_md: **Rockstar UK staff reject IWGB union recognition**, 75.3% against on a 93.2% turnout
items.summary_md: The ballot of 1,544 voters ran Nov. 12–26, through the GTA VI launch; the union says it will keep organizing.

items.headline_md: **GTA VI** made **£32 million** at UK physical retail in three days, **74%** of all boxed sales
items.summary_md: It's the biggest boxed first week since FIFA 20, even though the box holds only a code; PS5 sales rose 46%.

items.headline_md: **The Witcher 3 Remastered patch 5.02** fixes lighting, time-reversal and "bald Geralt" bugs
items.summary_md: It's out on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Switch 2, and outdated mods now get disabled instead of crashing the game.

items.headline_md: **Marvelous** seeks about **65 voluntary departures** in its game division
items.summary_md: It's restructuring development to focus on titles that fit its strengths, Famitsu reports.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still not public. u/Mindstormman's GitHub has 0 public repos and no general Wii U lifter has appeared; Reddit (r/decomps, r/emulation) blocked us today. New single-game Wii U recomps did show up (see E2 and [Native Splatoon 1 Recomp](https://github.com/xF4Mz/Native-Splatoon-1-Recomp-AMD-PORT), a dev-only AMD build).

items.headline_md: Update, GTA VI: Take-Two had GitHub disable the **Leonida** PC port and **3,007 repos**, and the **CGBJ** port vanished after hitting **25–30 fps**
items.summary_md: GitHub's own X account praised the PS5-to-PC tool AnyPS5, then deleted the post; Rockstar has announced no PC version, so any PC copy is built on leaked files.

items.headline_md: Wii U: **3dWorldRecomp**, a static recomp of **Super Mario 3D World** (RedCarpet.rpx) to native **Android and PC**, appears on GitHub
items.summary_md: It translates the PowerPC code to C ahead of time and draws GX2 graphics with Vulkan, with no CPU or GPU emulation; bring your own dump.

items.headline_md: Wii: **Other M Recompiled v1.0.1** adds Japanese voices, eight text languages and bloom options
items.summary_md: The native Metroid: Other M port runs on Windows, Linux, Mac and (early) Android from your own USA disc image.

items.headline_md: Switch recomps: **Moon River v0.3.0** (Bayonetta 2) adds controller rebinding, alongside **XC2 NS2 Recomp v0.2.7** and a **Yo-kai Watch 1** recomp beta
items.summary_md: All three are native Windows builds; Moon River also runs on Linux.

items.headline_md: **Xenia Edge** ships two builds with GPU pacing changes, and a **shadPS4** nightly rolls up **97 commits**
items.summary_md: shadPS4's build fixes Windows text encoding, GT Sport audio and file handling; Xenia Edge drops its debugger and savestates.

items.headline_md: **5DO 1.19.0** adds direct-IP **netplay** to the 3DO emulator
items.summary_md: Hosts send compressed machine states over TCP and inputs over UDP, and reconnects resume from the host's state.

items.headline_md: Update: **Sunrise on the Reaping** took **$15.1M** Wednesday, the franchise's second-best day before Thanksgiving
items.summary_md: Only 2013's Catching Fire ($20.8M) did better; Deadline still sees a 3-day of $58M+ and $85M+ over five days.

items.headline_md: Update: Disney's **Hexed** opened with **$7.6M** Wednesday, and its five-day outlook slips to **$31M–$35M**
items.summary_md: Variety now expects the $200M-plus animated film to finish third behind Focker In-Law.

items.headline_md: Update: **Focker-in-Law** grossed **$5.3M** on opening day with a **B+ CinemaScore**, pointing to about **$36.3M** over five days
items.summary_md: That's below the $45M range first projected.

items.headline_md: This year's **Thanksgiving frame** is expected to land below both 2024's record **$423M** and last year's **$290M**
items.summary_md: THR also warns the East Coast storm could slow moviegoing, including on Black Friday.

items.headline_md: Fincher's **The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth** looks like about **$5M** over five days on **252 Imax screens**
items.summary_md: The Netflix film starts streaming Dec. 23.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI** fixed a billing bug, so ChatGPT users will hit **GPT-6.2 Astra** limits **40% faster** and **Sol** limits 25% faster
items.summary_md: Eligible subscribers get an extra usage reset, Business users get free Fast Mode through 2026, and OpenAI is testing a combined Chat and Work experience.

items.headline_md: **Neuralink** gets **FDA approval** for a pivotal US trial of its brain implant in people with severe paralysis from **ALS**
items.summary_md: The same day, the Bank of England warned that AI financing makes it more likely that financial stress spreads between markets.

items.headline_md: **Anthropic rewrote the Claude API in Rust**, cutting CPU per request by about **70%** and median time to first token by **20%**
items.summary_md: Months of shadowing live traffic took the match rate to 99.6%, and an audit caught 100+ weakened test assertions.

items.headline_md: **Microsoft** ties hackers linked to **China and North Korea** to **ARTEX**, an agentic AI intrusion framework
items.summary_md: Microsoft says weak defenses can be breached within minutes, following an earlier FBI warning on the tool.

items.headline_md: **Canada** adds **C$700 million** to its AI Compute Access Fund, bringing it to **C$1 billion**
items.summary_md: It will cover up to 80% of eligible compute costs for businesses that use qualifying sovereign cloud providers.

items.headline_md: App stores: a judge orders **Apple to hand Epic 3,200 documents** it had marked not relevant, **by Dec. 8**
items.summary_md: Judge Thomas Hixson said Apple's rate was "so dramatically low that it raises red flags."

items.headline_md: Ads: some **iPhone apps push ads through Live Activities and promo alerts**, despite App Store rules
items.summary_md: AliExpress put ads in Live Activities, and DoorDash, Skip, McDonald's and Wendy's were flagged over promo notifications.

items.headline_md: Ads: buyers **bid more on in-app ads that carry a device ID** in 3 of 4 regions, a Blasto report finds
items.summary_md: In the EU, at most 69% of in-app ad requests carry all four signals buyers check.

items.headline_md: Remove any **Chrome extension called "Google Sheets"**: the **Remus** infostealer uses one to read Gmail
items.summary_md: Changing your password doesn't stop it, Gen Digital found; removing the extension does.

items.headline_md: **Amazon workers in 20+ countries** plan strikes and protests on Black Friday and Cyber Monday
items.summary_md: Engadget reports Verdi strikes at 11 German sites and Teamsters protests in Los Angeles and Chicago.

items.headline_md: **Apple's Black Friday** gift-card offer runs **Nov. 27–30**, with cards up to **$300** in the US
items.summary_md: Newer models, including the iPhone 18 Pro and MacBook Neo, are left out.

sections.title: Markets
sections.body_md: Shortened session today: stocks close at **12 PM CT**, CME equity futures at **12:15 PM CT**, bonds at **1 PM CT** ([QuantVPS](https://www.quantvps.com/market-hours/holidays)).

items.summary_md: Tech is leading a rebound after November's AI selloff.

items.headline_md: Premarket around 4:30 AM CT: **Nvidia +4.2%** ($155.20), **Micron +6.4%**, **Sandisk +10.8%**, **AMD +5%**
items.summary_md: Anthropic rose 3.6% to $85.73, back above its $83 IPO price.
Yahoo ties oil's gain to stepped-up Houthi attacks on Saudi energy sites.
Both are up from Thursday's close.

items.headline_md: The **10-year Treasury yield** fell to about **4.84%**, per Yahoo at 5 AM CT
items.summary_md: There's no major earnings or economic data today.

items.headline_md: **St. Peters**: mostly cloudy, high near **42°** then falling to about 38° this afternoon, low around **31°** tonight; dry today
items.summary_md: West wind 5–13 mph; rain is likely Saturday night (90%) and Sunday (80%), with no active alerts.

items.headline_md: **Berkeley**: mostly cloudy, high near **42°** then falling to about 38° this afternoon, low around **32°** tonight; dry today
items.summary_md: West wind 7–14 mph; rain is likely Saturday night and Sunday (90%), with no active alerts.

items.headline_md: **Cautious consumers gear up for Black Friday as inflation woes bite**
items.summary_md: Reuters lays out the stress under healthy holiday forecasts: 3.8% inflation, toy prices up 13.2% this year, and why AI may push the best deals closer to Christmas.
